item.title: National Assembly Speaker Election: Cho Jung-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, Park Jee-won in Three-Way Race (국회의장 조정식·김태년·박지원 3파전)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Election: Cho Jung-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, Park Jee-won in Three-Way Race (국회의장 조정식·김태년·박지원 3파전)

The election for the Speaker of the National Assembly for the second half of the 22nd term will be a three-way race among Democratic Party lawmakers Cho Jung-sik (6th term), Kim Tae-nyeon (5th term), and Park Jee-won (5th term). The final candidate for the National Assembly Speaker will be selected through an online vote (20%) among Democratic Party rights-bearing members on the 11th and 12th, followed by an on-site vote (80%) among Democratic Party lawmakers on the 13th. (22대 후반기 국회의장 선거가 더불어민주당 조정식(6선)·김태년(5선)·박지원(5선) 의원의 3파전으로 치러진다. 국회의장 최종 후보는 오는 11∼12일 민주당 권리당원 온라인 투표(20%)와 13일 민주당 의원 현장 투표(80%)를 통해 선출된다.)

Lawmakers Cho Jung-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, and Park Jee-won held a press conference on the 4th and declared their candidacies for the National Assembly Speaker election. All three put forward constitutional amendments, including a four-year presidential term limit enabling re-election, as their platform. Since the largest party in the National Assembly finalizes its candidate through an internal primary followed by a vote in the plenary session, the winner of the Democratic Party's primary effectively becomes the National Assembly Speaker. (조정식·김태년·박지원 의원은 4일 기자회견을 열고 국회의장 선거 출마를 선언했다. 세 사람 모두 임기 내 대통령 4년 연임제 등을 포함한 개헌을 공약으로 내세웠다. 국회의장은 원내 1당이 당내 경선을 통해 후보를 확정한 뒤 본회의 표결로 선출하기 때문에 민주당 경선 승자가 사실상 국회의장이 된다.)

Lawmaker Cho Jung-sik said on this day, "As a National Assembly Speaker from the ruling party with blue blood flowing from the Democratic Party, I will work with President Lee Jae-myung's government to create tangible results that the people can feel, and lay the groundwork for victory in the 23rd general election and, further, for the re-creation of the administration." Cho is positioning himself as a key figure within the pro-Lee faction. (조정식 의원은 이날 “민주당의 파란 피가 흐르는 집권 여당 출신 국회의장으로서 이재명 정부와 함께 국민이 체감하는 성과를 만들고 23대 총선 승리, 나아가 정권 재창출의 교두보를 놓겠다”고 했다. 조 의원은 친명계 핵심 인사임을 내세우고 있다.)

Lawmaker Kim Tae-nyeon stated, "I will be a working speaker, not one focused on protocol," and "I aim to create a model of a National Assembly Speaker who is good at getting things done, by uniting the will of the 300 lawmakers, who are individual constitutional institutions, to design the nation's direction and accomplish it together." Kim, a five-term lawmaker from Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, also emphasizes his connection with President Lee, who served as Seongnam's mayor. (김태년 의원은 “의전이 아니라 일하는 의장이 되겠다”며 “1인 헌법기관인 300명 의원의 뜻을 모아 국가의 방향을 설계하고 함께 완수하는 일 잘하는 국회의장상을 만들겠다”고 했다. 경기 성남 지역 5선인 김 의원 역시 성남시장을 지낸 이 대통령과 인연을 강조하고 있다.)

Lawmaker Park Jee-won said on this day, "This is my last time. I really want to serve once as the National Assembly Speaker," and "As the most outstanding National Assembly Speaker, I will work for the country, the people, and the success of President Lee Jae-myung." Park, citing his experience, is appealing for support in the Honam region, which has the largest number of rights-bearing party members. For the National Assembly Deputy Speaker election, four-term lawmakers Min Hong-chul and Nam In-soon have thrown their hats into the ring. (박지원 의원은 이날 “저는 이번이 마지막이다. 국회의장 꼭 한번 해보고 싶다”며 “가장 훌륭한 국회의장으로서 나라를, 국민을, 이재명 대통령의 성공을 위해 노력하겠다”고 했다. 박 의원은 경륜을 내세우며 권리당원 수가 가장 많은 호남에 지지를 호소하고 있다. 국회부의장 선거엔 4선의 민홍철, 남인순 의원이 도전장을 냈다.)

item.title: “Lee Jang-woo’s Arrogance and Lack of Communication… Push for Daejeon-Chungnam Integration Immediately” (“이장우 오만·불통… 대전·충남 통합 즉시 추진”)
item.description:
“Lee Jang-woo’s Arrogance and Lack of Communication… Push for Daejeon-Chungnam Integration Immediately” (“이장우 오만·불통… 대전·충남 통합 즉시 추진”)

In an interview with this newspaper on the 4th, Heo Tae-jeong, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for mayor of Daejeon, described the past four years of the current mayor, Lee Jang-woo of the People Power Party, saying, “In a word, it was ‘one-sided city administration without citizens,’” adding, “He has focused only on ‘showy’ large-scale events while turning his back on people’s livelihoods.” Candidate Heo stated, “I am different from Mayor Lee,” and emphasized, “This election is about ending an administration of ‘incompetence, lack of communication, and arrogance.’ I will bring the national driving force of the Lee Jae-myung administration to Daejeon and lead a real economic revival.” He continued, “If I am elected, my top priority will be to revive the struggling livelihood economy.” Candidate Heo was elected mayor of Daejeon in the 2018 local elections but lost to Mayor Lee four years later by a margin of 2.39 percentage points. This election marks a rematch between the current and former mayors. (더불어민주당 허태정 대전시장 후보는 4일 본지 인터뷰에서 국민의힘 이장우 현 시장의 지난 4년 시정에 대해 “한마디로 ‘시민 없는 일방 시정’이었다”며 “‘보여주기식’ 대형 행사에만 몰두하면서 민생은 외면해왔다”고 했다. 허 후보는 “나는 이 시장과는 다르다”며 “이번 선거는 ‘무능·불통·오만’ 시정을 청산하는 선거다. 이재명 정부의 국정 동력을 대전으로 끌어와 실질적인 경제 부흥을 이끌겠다”고 했다. 이어 “내가 당선된다면 말라 죽어가는 민생 경제 회복에 최우선을 두겠다”고 했다. 허 후보는 2018년 지방선거 때 대전시장에 당선됐다가 4년 뒤 선거에서 이 시장에게 2.39% 포인트 차이로 진 바 있다. 이번 선거는 전현직 시장의 리턴 매치다.)

-What is the atmosphere like at the local level? (-지역 현장 분위기는 어떤가.)

“The most common sentiment I hear on the ground is that President Lee Jae-myung is doing a really good job and working hard. There are also strong voices of anger that the People Power Party is constantly obstructing the Lee Jae-myung administration. Many people say that the local economy is already struggling, and high oil prices are making life even harder.” (“현장에서 가장 많이 듣는 얘기는 이재명 대통령이 정말 잘하고 있고 열심히 하고 있다는 평가다. 국민의힘이 사사건건 이재명 정부 발목을 잡는 데 대해 분노하는 목소리도 거세다. 가뜩이나 지역 경제가 어려운데 고유가로 살기 더 팍팍해졌다는 말씀들을 많이 하신다.”)

-The administrative integration of Daejeon and Chungnam, which the president pushed for, fell through. What will you do if elected? (-대통령이 추진했던 대전·충남 행정통합이 불발됐다. 당선되면 어떻게 할 건가.)

“Integration is a path we must take. If elected, I will immediately form a consultative body with local government heads in the Chungcheong region responsible for the integration and propose a roadmap. Through pilot projects in transportation, industry, and tourism, I will demonstrate that there are substantial benefits. If necessary, I will seek the opinions of citizens through a resident vote to proceed.” (“통합은 반드시 가야 할 길이다. 당선되면 통합에 책임이 있는 충청권 단체장들과 협의체를 즉시 구성하고 로드맵을 제안하겠다. 교통·산업·관광 등 시범 사업을 통해 실익이 많다는 것을 증명하겠다. 필요하다면 주민 투표 방식으로 시민들 의사를 물어 추진하겠다.”)

-You have defined this election as ‘judging the insurrection forces.’ What do you mean? (-이번 선거를 ‘내란 세력 심판’이라고 규정했는데.)

“What did Mayor Lee do during the December 3 martial law? The mayor is responsible for the safety and lives of citizens. But Mayor Lee did not fulfill that duty. He even attended rallies opposing the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk-yeol. Look at Mayor Lee’s administration. It can be summed up as erasing the achievements of the previous mayor, lack of communication and self-righteousness, muzzling the press, and personnel abuses. He is ‘Little Yoon Suk-yeol.’ We must decisively oust the insurrection forces with an overwhelming victory.” (“이 시장은 12·3 계엄 때 뭘 했는가. 시장은 시민들의 안전과 생명을 책임져야 한다. 하지만 이 시장은 그러지 않았다. 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵 반대 집회도 나갔다. 이 시장 시정을 보라. 전임 시장 업적 지우기, 불통과 독선, 언론 재갈 물리기, 인사 전횡 등으로 요약된다. ‘리틀 윤석열’이다. 압도적 승리로 내란 세력을 반드시 몰아내야 한다.")

-Mayor Lee said in an interview with this newspaper that your pledge to provide 200,000 won in relief funds for high oil price damage was ‘populist money scattering.’ He also claimed your return as mayor would mean regression for Daejeon. (-이 시장은 본지 인터뷰에서 고유가 피해 지원금 20만원을 지급하겠다는 허 후보 공약을 ‘선심성 돈 뿌리기’라고 했다. 허 후보의 시장 복귀는 대전의 퇴보라고도 했는데.)

“That’s a remark befitting a mayor who doesn’t care about people’s livelihoods. While the livelihood economy is withering, Mayor Lee cut the budget for local currency, intensifying the suffering of ordinary people. He even tells me not to pledge support for citizens hit by high oil prices. He has budget for showy events like the ‘0 o’clock Festival’ but no budget for caring for people’s livelihoods? I would ask him back about that. He has essentially admitted his own incompetence.” (“민생을 챙기지 않는 시장다운 말이다. 이 시장은 민생 경제가 말라 죽어가는데도 지역 화폐 예산을 줄여 서민 고통을 가중시켰다. 고유가 피해 시민들을 지원하겠다는 공약도 하지 말라고 한다. ‘0시 축제’ 같은 보여주기식 행사에 쓸 예산은 있고 민생을 돌볼 예산은 없는지 되묻겠다. 무능함을 스스로 인정한 것이다.”)

-Mayor Lee said that regarding the issuance of 1.6 trillion won in local bonds during his tenure, it was money spent to clean up the projects left by you, the predecessor. (-이 시장은 본인 재임 당시 1조6000억원의 지방채를 발행한 데 대해선 “전임 시장인 허 후보가 벌려놓은 사업을 수습하느라 쓴 것”이라고 했다.)

“It is true that I issued local bonds during my tenure. They were necessary expenses for economic recovery amid the COVID-19 pandemic crisis and for purchasing park land to prevent haphazard development of city parks. Many still say it was sound administration. But Mayor Lee does not explain why local bonds also increased by hundreds of billions of won during his time in office. Isn’t it the responsible attitude of a mayor to properly explain that reason to citizens himself?” (“제가 재임할 당시 지방채를 발행한 것은 맞다. 코로나 팬데믹 위기 속 경기 회복, 도시공원 난개발을 막기 위한 공원 토지 매입 등 필수적인 지출이었다. 지금도 잘한 행정이라는 평가가 많다. 그런데 이 시장 재임 당시에도 지방채가 수천억 원 증가한 이유에 대해선 설명하지 않는다. 본인도 그 이유를 시민들에게 제대로 설명하는 것이 책임 있는 시장의 자세 아닌가.”)

-If elected, what will you do first? (-당선된다면 뭘 먼저 하겠나.)

“I will create changes that citizens can feel immediately. I will place the administration’s focus on citizens and support those suffering from the effects of high oil prices. I will revive the local currency ‘Ontong Daejeon’ that Mayor Lee abolished. I will implement an upgraded version, ‘Ontong Daejeon 2.0,’ which will pay policy allowances such as youth support funds, civil servant welfare points, and carbon reduction incentives in the local currency. I hope to hear people say, ‘Life was much better when Heo Tae-jeong was mayor.’” (“시민들이 당장 체감할 수 있는 변화를 만들겠다. 시정의 중심을 시민에 두고 고유가 피해로 신음하는 시민들을 지원하겠다. 이 시장이 폐지한 지역화폐 ‘온통 대전’을 부활시키겠다. 청년 지원금, 공무원 복지 포인트, 탄소 감축 인센티브 등 정책 수당도 지역 화폐로 지급하는 업그레이드 버전 ‘온통 대전 2.0’을 시행하겠다. ‘허태정이가 시장일 때 삶이 훨씬 나아졌다’는 이야기를 듣고 싶다.”)

-How will you retain the young people who are leaving? (-떠나는 청년들을 어떻게 붙잡을 것인가.)

“I will create a ‘Daejeon Youth Special City’ where young people can find housing and jobs without difficulty and enjoy cultural activities. There are so many research institutes in Daejeon, aren’t there? I plan to support connecting university experience with recruitment that reflects the actual needs of these research institutes. I will revitalize startup employment and create youth housing focused on urban convergence zones and station areas to reduce housing burdens. Above all, I will empower young people not just as policy beneficiaries but as active agents, making Daejeon a city designed by the youth themselves.” (“청년들이 어려움 없이 주거 공간, 일자리를 구할 수 있고 문화도 누릴 수 있는 ‘대전 청년특별시’를 만들겠다. 대전에 수많은 연구소가 있지 않나. 대학 경험이 연구소의 실제 수요를 반영한 채용으로 연계되도록 지원할 계획이다. 스타트업 취업을 활성화하고 도심 융합 특구와 역세권 중심의 청년 주택을 조성해 주거 부담을 줄이겠다. 무엇보다 청년을 단순한 정책 수혜자가 아닌 주체로 세워 청년이 직접 설계하는 도시로 만들겠다.”)

-What measures can further revitalize Daejeon as a city of startups and research? (-창업·연구 도시 대전을 더욱 부흥시킬 수 있는 대책은.)

“The core of science and industry policy is ‘connection.’ By building AI industry infrastructure, I will select and actively foster strategic industries such as defense AX (AI transformation) clusters, AI semiconductors, and advanced sensors. I will link the research outcomes of the Daedeok Innopolis with businesses to increase job and startup opportunities. I will make Daejeon a hub for innovative growth in South Korea.” (“과학 산업 정책의 핵심은 ‘연결’이다. AI 산업 인프라를 구축해 방산AX(인공 지능 전환) 클러스터, AI 반도체·첨단 센서 등 전략 산업을 선정해 적극 육성하겠다. 대덕 특구의 연구 성과를 사업으로 연결해 일자리와 창업 기회를 늘리겠다. 대전을 대한민국 혁신 성장의 거점으로 만들겠다.”)

-There is one month left until the election. (-선거가 한 달 남았다.)

“I will personally reach out to every citizen in every alley and spread the word about tangible livelihood policies as much as possible. I will clearly explain how much more a mayor aligned with the Lee Jae-myung administration can bring to Daejeon and highlight the difference. Rather than grand slogans, I will show the process of citizens’ lives changing one by one. I will run with ultimate humility and a low profile until the very end.” (“골목 구석구석 시민 한 분 한 분께 직접 다가가 체감할 수 있는 민생 정책을 최대한 알리겠다. 이재명 정부와 손발이 맞는 시장이 대전에 얼마나 더 많은 걸 가져올 수 있는지, 그 차이를 분명히 설명하겠다. 거창한 구호보다 실제 시민의 삶이 하나둘 바뀌어 가는 과정을 보여드리겠다. 마지막까지 더 겸손하고 낮은 자세로 뛰겠다.”)

☞Who is Heo Tae-jeong? (☞허태정은 누구)

Born in Yesan, Chungnam, he graduated from Daejeon Daeseong High School and Chungnam National University with a degree in Philosophy. He served as a secretary for the Chungnam Democratic Youth Alliance and later worked as an administrative officer in the Office of the Senior Secretary for Political Affairs and the Office of the Senior Secretary for Personnel under the Roh Moo-hyun administration. After serving two consecutive terms as the head of Yuseong-gu, he was elected mayor of Daejeon in the 2018 local elections. He lost to current Mayor Lee Jang-woo in the 2022 local elections and is now facing a rematch. (충남 예산 출신으로 대전 대성고와 충남대 철학과를 졸업했다. 충남민주운동청년연합 간사를 거쳐 노무현 정부 청와대 정무수석실, 인사수석실 행정관으로 일했다. 유성구청장을 연임한 뒤 2018년 지방선거에서 대전시장에 당선됐다. 2022년 지방선거에서 이장우 현 시장에게 패배했고 이번에 리턴 매치를 치른다.)

item.title: Concerned about Worsening Public Opinion… “Lee Ordered to Process the Special Counsel Bill After the Election” (여론 악화 가능성에… “李, 선거 후 특검법 처리하라는 주문한 것”)
item.description:
Concerned about Worsening Public Opinion… “Lee Ordered to Process the Special Counsel Bill After the Election” (여론 악화 가능성에… “李, 선거 후 특검법 처리하라는 주문한 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung’s instruction on the 4th to the Democratic Party to “deliberate (on the timing and procedures)” regarding the handling of the “fabricated indictment special counsel bill” that would allow for the withdrawal of the indictment in his own case is interpreted as a measure mindful of worsening public opinion ahead of the June 3 local elections. Previously, concerns and criticism had been raised not only within the Democratic Party but also among the broader pro-government bloc, including the Justice Party. <<> On this day, the Korea Economic Justice Institute also issued a statement saying, “There are serious constitutional concerns,” and demanded, “Immediately review and delete the provision granting the authority to withdraw indictments.” A government source said, “Considering the negative impact on the local elections, President Lee issued the directive to ‘process the special counsel bill after the election.’” <<> Initially, when pro-Lee lawmakers, including former lawyers related to President Lee’s case, proposed the special counsel bill on the 30th of last month, the presidential office maintained distance, stating, “It is an issue being discussed in the National Assembly, and we have no particular stance.” However, as opinions emerged, particularly from Democratic Party candidates in the Yeongnam region like Daegu and Busan, that “the atmosphere is concerning,” it appears they brought up “deliberation” on the timing and procedures. Nevertheless, regarding the presidential office’s public mention of the need for the special counsel bill, the opposition party claimed, “The President has directly expressed his will to push forward with the special counsel bill after the election.” <<> After the presidential office announced its position, the Democratic Party immediately stated its intention to go through a process of gathering opinions on the bill. Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae said in a press conference, “There is internal party opinion regarding the timing or specific content of processing the special counsel bill,” adding, “We will assess the views and make a decision through internal discussions.” Lawmaker Han Byung-do also told reporters, “We will deliberate internally on the legislative process and gather more public opinion,” and said, “We intend to proceed by solidifying the process.” <<> Initially, the party leadership had planned to immediately process the fabricated indictment special counsel bill proposed on the 30th of last month. As of that morning, it was known that they were considering submitting it to a plenary session on the 7th and processing it before the local elections. Democratic Party Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, before the presidential office’s statement, argued for the swift processing of the special counsel bill at a Supreme Council meeting, stating, “The special counsel is a historical duty for realizing judicial justice and a process of judicial normalization to correct the errors of the Yoon Seok-yeol prosecution’s dictatorial regime.” <<> Amidst this, the presidential office’s call for “slowing down the special counsel bill” is believed to stem from the judgment that the controversy could negatively impact not only the Yeongnam region but also the local elections in the Seoul metropolitan area. In the Democratic Party’s Telegram group chat involving about 150 lawmakers, opinions emerged that “the handling of the special counsel bill should be postponed until after the local elections.” Lawmaker Kwon Chil-seung, co-chair of the joint election committee for Democratic Party Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Boo-kyum’s campaign, reportedly posted in the chat that day, “Discussion on the special counsel bill will not only affect the Yeongnam elections but also the Seoul metropolitan area,” and that “the handling of the special counsel bill should be postponed until after the local elections.” Lawmaker Lim Mi-ae, chair of the Democratic Party’s Gyeongbuk Provincial Party, reportedly also suggested, “Forcing through the special counsel bill could affect the overall elections. I ask the leadership to give it careful thought.” Candidate Kim Boo-kyum said on the 3rd regarding the special counsel bill, “If they don’t intend to abandon their running comrades, I would ask them to be cautious.” <<> On this day, Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party and candidate in the by-election for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul constituency, issued a statement saying, “Withdrawing the indictment in President Lee’s case is justified,” but added, “The ‘optimal path’ to withdraw the indictment via the special counsel bill is not right away, but to find it through in-depth discussion after the election.” The Justice Party opposes the special counsel bill. <<> However, some in the government bloc predict that the special counsel bill will be passed before the election. A government source said, “After the election, the situation is unpredictable due to debates over responsibility for the election results and changes in party leadership following the Democratic Party’s leadership election in August, so there could be arguments from the pro-Lee faction to process the special counsel bill, which is directly linked to withdrawing the indictment in President Lee’s case, before the election.” (이재명 대통령이 4일 본인 사건의 공소 취소가 가능하도록 한 ‘조작 기소 특검 법안’ 처리와 관련, 더불어민주당에 “(시기와 절차를) 숙의하라”고 한 것은 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 여론 악화를 의식한 조치로 풀이된다. 앞서 민주당 내부뿐 아니라 정의당 등 범여권에서도 우려와 비판이 제기되는 상황이었다.)

item.title: Opposition Rallies Against Dropped Indictment Special Counsel... "Beginning a Nationwide Resistance Movement" (공소취소 특검 앞에 뭉친 야권… “범국민 저항 운동 시작”)
item.description:
Opposition Rallies Against Dropped Indictment Special Counsel... "Beginning a Nationwide Resistance Movement" (공소취소 특검 앞에 뭉친 야권… “범국민 저항 운동 시작”)

Candidates from the People Power Party and the Reform Party for metropolitan and regional leadership positions in the Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Incheon areas gathered on the 4th to block the passage of a special counsel bill aimed at enabling the dismissal of indictments in President Lee Jae-myung's case. This marks the first instance of candidate collaboration between the two parties ahead of the June 3 local elections. In a joint statement, they declared, "President Lee Jae-myung must clearly state to the public that there will be absolutely no dismissal of charges against him during his term, and that he will stand trial according to the law and principles." (국민의힘과 개혁신당의 서울·경기·인천 등 수도권 광역단체장 후보들이 4일 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있도록 한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 처리 저지를 위해 모였다. 6·3 지방선거 양당 간 후보 연대는 처음이다. 이들은 공동 성명문에서 “이재명 대통령은 ‘임기 중 나의 혐의에 대한 공소 취소는 절대 없으며 법과 원칙에 따라 재판을 받겠다’는 점을 국민 앞에 분명히 선언하라”고 했다.)

Five candidates—Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Gyeonggi Governor candidate Yang Hyang-ja, and Incheon Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok from the People Power Party, along with Reform Party Gyeonggi Governor candidate Jo Eung-cheon and Seoul Mayor candidate Kim Jeong-cheol—said in the statement, "We are launching a nationwide resistance movement to prevent a judicial coup." The statement called for the withdrawal of the Democratic Party's special counsel bill, a public declaration by President Lee opposing the dismissal of indictments, statements from Democratic Party metropolitan candidates including Jeong Won-oh, Choo Mi-ae, and Park Chan-dae, and the promotion of a nationwide online signature campaign. (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장·양향자 경기지사·유정복 인천시장 후보와 개혁신당 조응천 경기지사·김정철 서울시장 후보 등 5명은 이날 성명에서 “사법 쿠데타를 막기 위한 범국민 저항 운동을 시작한다”고 했다. 성명문에선 민주당 특검법안 철회, 이 대통령의 ‘공소 취소 반대’ 공개 선언, 정원오·추미애·박찬대 등 민주당 수도권 후보들의 입장 발표, 범국민 온라인 서명 운동 등을 촉구·추진하기로 했다.)

The candidates issued this statement after holding an emergency joint meeting of metropolitan and regional leadership candidates for the Seoul metropolitan area, titled "To Prevent Judicial Insurrection," at the National Assembly. The meeting was arranged after Jo Eung-cheon proposed it the previous day and Oh Se-hoon accepted. (이들은 이날 국회에서 ‘사법내란 저지를 위한 수도권 광역단체장 후보자 긴급 연석회의’를 진행한 뒤 이 같은 성명을 발표했다. 이날 회의는 전날 조응천 후보가 제안하고 오세훈 후보가 수락하면서 성사됐다.)

Candidate Jo said, "The arrogant and reckless Lee Jae-myung administration has united us metropolitan candidates." In response, Oh stated, "On this matter, no matter how busy the local election schedule is, we must join forces and absolutely prevent this. All political factions must come together with extraordinary resolve and determination." Candidate Yoo Jeong-bok added, "Today's meeting must not end as a one-time event," while Kim Jeong-cheol emphasized, "Acts that shake the foundation of the rule of law must not occur." (조 후보는 “오만하고 무도한 이재명 정권이 수도권 후보들을 하나로 뭉치게 했다”고 말했다. 이에 오 후보는 “이번 일만큼은 아무리 지방선거 일정이 바쁘더라도 마음을 모아야 하고 절대 저지해야 한다. 모든 정파가 모여 비상한 결의와 각오로 임해야 한다”고 했다. 유정복 후보는 “오늘 만남이 일회성으로 끝나선 안 된다”고 했고, 김정철 후보는 “법치주의 근간을 흔드는 행위는 있어선 안 된다”고 했다.)

In political circles, there is talk that this joint meeting has opened the door for opposition alliance collaboration. Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok told reporters, "If People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk proposes party-level measures for struggle and is willing to discuss with the Reform Party, I am open to making space for dialogue." The leadership of the People Power Party has also indicated a willingness to engage in opposition collaboration. However, candidate Yang Hyang-ja said on KBS Radio regarding unification with Jo Eung-cheon, "I am not thinking about it at all right now." Yang attended only the commemorative photo session prior to the joint meeting and then left. (정치권에선 이번 연석회의를 계기로 야권 연대가 물꼬를 텄다는 얘기가 나온다. 개혁신당 이준석 대표는 기자들과 만나 “국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 당 차원 투쟁 방안을 제시하고 개혁신당과 논의하겠다면 공간을 열고 대화할 생각이 있다”고 했다. 국민의힘 지도부도 야권 연대에 열려 있다는 입장이다. 다만 양향자 후보는 이날 KBS 라디오에서 조응천 후보와의 단일화에 대해 “지금은 전혀 생각을 안 하고 있다”고 했다. 양 후보는 이날 연석회의에 앞선 기념 촬영에만 참석하고 자리를 떴다.)

item.title: I Will Become a Righteous One Who Died Fighting for the Homeland (조국을 위해 싸우다 죽은 의인이 되겠다)
item.description:
I Will Become a Righteous One Who Died Fighting for the Homeland (조국을 위해 싸우다 죽은 의인이 되겠다)

After being placed under his second house arrest, YS deeply contemplated 'death'. In his diary entry of June 21, 1982, he titled it 'The Value of Life'. He speaks of the life of "a righteous one who died fighting for the homeland, for justice, for truth." (YS는 2차 가택연금을 당한 이후 ‘죽음’에 대해 깊이 생각합니다. 1982년 6월 21일 일기에는 ‘삶의 가치’라는 제목을 달았습니다. “조국을 위해서 정의를 위하여 진실을 위하여 싸우다가 죽은 의인”의 삶을 말합니다.)

"Though it may seem like a momentary death, if you think of it as living forever, you will not be discouraged but gain courage. The path of justice, the right path, the path for the people, the path that considers the homeland—these are narrow, rugged, and painful paths. Yet these paths are not arduous; they are also paths of glory and paths of victory." (“잠시 죽는 것처럼 보이지마는 영원히 사는 것이라고 생각하면 좌절하지 않고 용기가 생기는 것이다. 정의로운 길, 바른 길, 국민을 위하는 길, 조국을 생각하는 길은 좁고 험하고 고통의 길이다. 그러나 이 길은 험한 길이 아니라 영광의 길이기도 하고 승리의 길이기도 하다.”)

In his diary entry of June 29, he titled it 'My Assertion'. He resolves, "If I devote the rest of my life to justice, to truth, and for the people, there is no greater glory than this." (6월 29일 일기에는 ‘나의 주장’이라는 제목을 달았습니다. “정의를 위하여 진실을 위하여 백성을 위하여 남은 일생을 바친다면 이 보다 영광이 없다”고 다짐합니다.)

He wrote, "My advocacy for freedom and democracy is never for me to seize power or for my own advancement." (“내가 자유와 민주주의를 주장하는 것은 나 자신이 정권을 잡기 위하여, 나 자신의 영달을 위하는 것은 결코 아니다”라고 적었습니다.)

All people in this world, though they do not know when or at what time, all die. Some live in this world for 30 years, some for 50 years, or some for 80 years and then die. Of course, a person's value is not judged by how long they lived in this world. (세상(世上)의 모던(*든) 사람들은 그것이 언제 어느 때인지는 모르지마는 다 죽는다. 어떤 사람은 30년(年) 혹(或)은 50년(年) 혹(或)은 80년간(年間)을 세상(世上)에 살다가 죽는다. 물론(勿論) 사람의 가치(價値)는 얼마나 오래동안(*오랫동안) 세상(世上)에 살았느냐 하는데서 그 사람의 평가를 하지는 않는다.)

Today, both the government and certain specific individuals lack truth and justice. Because there is no freedom of speech, the people do not know the truth. It would be good to evaluate a person's value by what they have done for the truth and justice of the homeland. Some individuals, like person A, die leaving behind much money. After their death, their children may feel grateful and thankful to their parents. (오늘날 정부(政府)나 어떠한 특(特)정인(人)까지도 진실(眞實)이 없고 정의(正義)가 없다. 언론(言論)의 자유(自由)가 없기 때문에 국민(囗民)들이 진실(眞實)을 알지 못한다. 조국(祖國)의 진실(眞實)을 위해서 정의(正義)를 위해서 무엇을 했느냐 하는데서 사람의 가치(價値)를 평가하는 것이 좋을 것이다. A라고 하는 어떤 사람은 많은 돈을 남기고 죽는 사람도 있다. 죽은 다음에 자식(子息)들은 감사(感謝)하다고 부모(父母)님들에게 고맙게 생각하는 사람도 있을 것이다.)

Person B, during their time in this world, may have asserted for 10 or 20 years what democracy is, only to deny it overnight and die. (B라고 하는 사람은 세상(世上)에 사는 동안에 자기자신(自己自身)이 10년(年) 혹(或)은 20년(年) 주장(主張)해오던 민주주의(民主主義)라고 하는 것이 이러한 것이다라고 말하던 것을 하로(*하루) 아침에 부정(否定)하고 살다가 죽어간 사람도 있다.)

Future generations will record in history that such a person lived and died basely and foully. (후세(后世) 사람들은 비굴하게 더럽게 살다가 죽었다고 역사(歷史)는 기록될 것이다.)

Person C died leaving behind many good books and artworks. People of the world might regret wishing they had lived longer to leave us even better books. (C라고 하는 사람은 많은 좋은 책과 예술품(品)을 남기고 죽었다. 세상(世上) 사람들은 좀 더 살아서 우리들에게 더 좋은 책들을 남겨주었으면 하고 아쉬워 할 것이다.)

If person D, while being persecuted and enduring all kinds of suffering, fights for freedom, justice, and truth, for the future of the homeland, and speaks out their views fairly and squarely, even knowing the pain, and then dies, future generations and history will call them a righteous one who died fighting for the homeland, for justice, for truth. (D라고 하는 사람은 핏박(*핍박)받으며 온갖 고통을 당(当)하면서 자유(自由)와 정의(正義)와 진실(眞實)을 위하여 조국(祖國)의 장래(將來)를 위해서 고통을 각오하고 정정당당(当当)하게 자기(自己) 주장(主張)을 펴다가 죽는다면 후세(后世)의 사람들과 역사(歷史)는 조국(祖國)을 위해서 정의(正義)를 위하여 진실(眞實)을 위하여 싸우다가 죽은 의인(義人)이라고 말할 것이다.)

No matter how much freedom of speech is absent today, the time will surely come when the truth is revealed. (아무리 오늘날 언론(言論)의 자유(自由)가 없다고 하지마는 어느 시기(時期)인가 진실(眞實)이 밣허(*밝혀)질 때가 반드시 오고야 말 것이다.)

A person's true value is in living and dying 'as a human being should live'. There may be nothing as difficult as living as a human being should. Human nature is such that everyone's heart is cunning, weak, and seeks the comfortable and broad path. But from a religious standpoint, though it may seem like 'a momentary death', if you think of it as living forever, you will not be discouraged but gain courage. The path of justice, the right path, the path for the people, the path that considers the homeland—these are narrow, rugged, and painful paths. Yet these paths are not arduous; they are also paths of glory and paths of victory. However, many intellectuals fear walking this narrow and rugged path. But truly wise and courageous people choose that rugged and painful path because it is the path of the victor. (사람의 참 가치(價値)는 ‘사람이 사람답게’ 살다가 죽는 것이다. 사람이 사람답게 산다고 하는 것만큼 어려운 일도 없을 것이다. 사람들의 마음은 그 어느 누구나 간사하고 약하고 편하고 넓은 길을 가구(*고) 싶은 것이 인간(人間)이다. 그러나 신앙적(的)인 입장(立場)에서 ‘잠시 죽는 것’처럼 보이지마는 영원(永遠)히 사는 것이라고 생각하면 자(*좌)절하지 않고 용기(勇氣)가 생기는 것이다. 정의(正義)로운 길 바른 길 국민(囗民)을 위하는 길 조국(祖國)을 생각하는 길은 좁고 험하고 고통의 길이다. 그러나 이 길은 험한 길이 아니라 영광(榮光)의 길이기도 하고 승리(勝利)의 길이기도 하다. 그러나 많은 지식인(知識人)들은 이 좁고 험한 길을 가기를 두려워한다. 그러나 진실(眞實)로 지(知)혜로운 사람 용기(勇氣)있는 사람은 그 험하고 고통스러운 길을 택하는 것이다. 이 길은 승리자(勝利者)의 길이기 때문이다.)

I love freedom. I love democracy. I love justice. (나는 자유(自由)를 사랑한다. 민주주의(民主主義)를 사랑한다. 정의(正義)를 사랑한다.)

From birth, every human naturally comes to think not only of their own freedom but also of the freedom of everyone around them. (인간(人間)은 누구나가 다 세상(世上)에 나면서부터 자기자신(自己自身)뿐 아니라 주변의 모든 사람들의 자유(自由)를 생각하게 되는 것이 인간(人間)이다.)

I advocate for freedom and democracy for my own freedom and for the freedom of the people. My advocacy for freedom and democracy is never for me to seize power or for my own advancement. If I wished to live peacefully at this present moment, to avoid such things as confinement, I could remain silent and be at peace. I believe that remaining silent in this unjust reality is a great sin. (나는 나 자신(自身)의 자유(自由)를 위하여 국민대중(囗民大衆)의 자유(自由)를 위하여 자유(自由)와 민주주의(民主主義)를 주장(主張)하는 것이다. 내가 자유(自由)와 민주주의(民主主義)를 주장(主張)하는 것이 나 자신(自身)이 정권(政權)을 잡기 위하여 나 자신(自身)의 영달(榮達)을 위해는 것은 결(決)코 아니다. 지금 이 현시점(現時點)에서 평안(平安)하게 살기를 원한다면 이렇게 연금 같은 것을 당(当)하지 않기 위해서는 침묵을 지키면 평안(平安)할 것이다. 나는 이렇게 옳지 아니한 현실(現實)에서 침묵을 지킨다는 것은 큰 죄악이라고 생각한다.)

In the communist country of the Soviet Union, when Sakharov advocates for freedom and human rights, it is certainly not to seize power in the Soviet Union. I believe he acts according to his conscience. (공산국가(共産國家)인 쏘련에서 ‘사하로프’가 자유(自由)와 인권(人權)을 주장(主張)하는 것은 결(決)코 쏘련에서 정권(政權)을 잡기 위해서가 아니다. 자기(自己)의 양심(良心)에 따라서 행동(行動)하는 것이라고 생각한다.)

How much more so in Korea. Even though it is not a communist country, demanding freedom and democracy for our people against such oppressive politics is a natural right and duty. I have received much love from the people. If so, I must repay that love in some way. I must repay for the people suffering on this land, for those whose human rights are trampled. (항차(*황차·하물며) 한국(韓囗)에서랴. 공산국가(共産國家)도 아닌데 이러한 탄압정치(彈壓政治)에 대항(對抗)해서 자유(自由)와 민주주의(民主主義)를 우리 국민(囗民)에게 달라고 하는 것은 당연(當然)한 권리(權利)요 의무(義務)이다. 나는 국민(囗民)으로부터 많은 사랑을 받아왔다. 그렇다면 그 국민(囗民)의 사랑에 대(対)해서 무엇인가 보답(報答)해야 한다. 내가 이땅에서 고통(苦痛) 당하고 있는 백성(百姓)들 인권(人權)이 짓밣인(*밢힌) 사람들을 위하여 무엇인가 보답(報答)해야 하는 것이다.)

It is certainly not for me to seize power. For the pitiful masses of the people, I must naturally assert what needs to be asserted. Even if I myself suffer any pain. In doing so, my heart and conscience can find peace. (내가 결(決)코 정권(政權)을 잡기 위해서가 아니다. 불쌍한 국민대중(囗民大衆)을 위해서 주장(主張)할 것은 당연(當然)히 주장(主張)해야 한다. 내 자신(自身)이 어떠한 고통(苦痛)을 당(当)할지라도 말이다. 그러할 때 나의 마음과 양심(良心)은 평안(平安)함을 얻을 수 있다.)

There is no saying as true as the one from Zhuangzi's writings: 'There is no greater sorrow than the death of the heart.' (장자(莊子)의 글 가운데 ‘비막대어심사(悲莫大於心死·*마음이 죽는 것보다 더 큰 슬픔은 없다)’라는 말처럼은 분명(分明)한 말은 없다.)

Our country's 'guiding principle must be democracy.' If I strive for this, I have no regrets. (우리나라의 ‘국시(囗是) 민주(民主)’여야 하는 것이다. 이것을 위하여 노력(努力)한다면 여한은 없다.)

There is no greater glory than to devote the rest of my life to justice, to truth, for the people. (정의(正義)를 위하여 진실(眞實)을 위하여 백성(百姓)을 위하야(*여) 남은 일생(一生)을 받(*바)친다면 이 보다 영광(榮光)이 없다.)

If I strive for the people who suffer injustice, for those who are trampled without power, for those whose human rights are ignored, God too will be pleased. For the glory of God. (억울함을 당(当)하는 백성(百姓)을 위하여 권력(權力)이 없어 짓밣임(*짓밟힘)을 당(当)하는 사람들 인권(人權)이 무시(無視)되고 있는 사람들을 위하여 노력(努力)한다면 하나님도 기쁘(*뻐)하실 것이다. 하나님의 영광(榮光)을 위하여.)

item.title: Further Narrowed Yeongnam… All Races in Busan, Northern Gap, Daegu within Margin of Error (더 좁혀진 영남… 부산·북갑·대구 모두 오차범위 접전)
item.description:
Further Narrowed Yeongnam… All Races in Busan, Northern Gap, Daegu within Margin of Error (더 좁혀진 영남… 부산·북갑·대구 모두 오차범위 접전)

With the June 3 local elections just a month away, poll results released on the 4th show candidates from the ruling and opposition parties locked in tight contests within the margin of error in the Yeongnam region. The initial trend favoring the Democratic Party of Korea is now shifting, rocked by the variable of conservative consolidation originating from Yeongnam. Polling experts said, "As the Democratic Party pushes the 'fabricated indictment' special counsel law, Yeongnam voters are starting to activate their check-and-balance mindset." (6·3 지방선거가 한 달 앞으로 다가온 가운데 영남권에서 여야 후보들이 오차 범위 내에서 접전을 벌이고 있다는 여론조사 결과가 4일 발표됐다. 더불어민주당 우세였던 선거 초반 흐름이 영남발 보수 결집이라는 변수로 요동치는 양상이다. 여론조사 전문가들은 “조작 기소 특검법을 밀어붙이는 민주당을 보면서, 영남권 유권자들의 견제 심리가 작동하기 시작한 것”이라고 했다.)

In a survey on suitability for Busan mayor commissioned by Busan MBC and conducted by Hankook Research on the 1st and 2nd among 1,013 Busan voters using wireless automated response (ARS), Democratic Party Busan mayor candidate Jeon Jae-soo received 46.9%, while People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon received 40.7%. The two are competing within the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points). (부산MBC 의뢰로 한길리서치가 지난 1~2일 부산 지역 유권자 1013명을 상대로 실시한 무선 자동응답(ARS) 방식의 부산시장 적합도 조사에서 전재수 민주당 부산시장 후보가 46.9%, 박형준 국민의힘 후보는 40.7%로 나타났다. 오차 범위(±3.1%포인트) 안에서 다투는 형국이다.)

In a survey commissioned by the same firm from the 1st to the 3rd in Busan's Northern Gap district, where a by-election for the National Assembly will be held, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo scored 34.3%, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon scored 33.5%. People Power Party preliminary candidate Park Min-shik received 21.5%. The People Power Party will announce its candidate for Busan's Northern Gap on the 5th. In hypothetical two-way matchups, Han Dong-hoon received 38.2% versus Ha Jung-woo's 37.4%, and Park Min-shik received 33.1% versus Ha Jung-woo's 39.7%. This survey was conducted among 584 residents of Busan's Northern Gap District using wireless ARS and wired random digit dialing (RDD). (같은 업체가 지난 1~3일 국회의원 보궐선거가 열리는 부산 북갑에서 실시한 조사에선 민주당 하정우 후보 34.3%, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 33.5%였다. 국민의힘 박민식 예비후보는 21.5%로 나타났다. 국민의힘은 5일 부산 북갑 후보를 발표한다. 가상 양자 대결에선 한동훈 후보 38.2% 대 하정우 후보 37.4%, 박민식 예비후보 33.1% 대 하정우 후보 39.7%로 집계됐다. 이 조사는 부산 북구갑 주민 584명을 대상으로 무선 ARS와 유선 임의번호걸기(RDD) 방식으로 실시했다.)

The Daegu mayoral election, initially leaning toward the Democratic Party due to internal strife over the People Power Party's nominations, is also entering a confused phase. In a wireless ARS survey commissioned by Daegu MBC and conducted by Ace Research on the 2nd and 3rd among 1,004 Daegu voters, Democratic Party Daegu mayor candidate Kim Boo-kyum received 45.9%, and People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho received 42.4%, within the margin of error (±3.1 percentage points). (선거 초반 국민의힘 공천 내홍으로 민주당이 앞서가던 대구시장 선거 판세도 혼전 국면으로 접어들고 있다. 대구MBC 의뢰로 에이스리서치가 지난 2~3일 대구 지역 유권자 1004명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 ARS 조사에서 민주당 김부겸 대구시장 후보 45.9%, 국민의힘 추경호 후보 42.4%로 오차 범위(±3.1%포인트) 내였다.)

In a hypothetical two-way matchup survey commissioned by Daegu MBC and Ace Research on the 18th and 19th of last month, the gap between Kim Boo-kyum (49.2%) and Choo Kyung-ho (35.1%) was 14.1 percentage points, but it turned into a close race within just two weeks. In a wireless phone interview survey commissioned by SBS and conducted by Ipsos from the 1st to the 3rd among 801 Daegu voters, Kim Boo-kyum received 41% and Choo Kyung-ho 36%, showing a tie within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). (대구MBC·에이스리서치가 지난달 18~19일 실시한 양자 가상 대결 조사에선 김부겸 후보(49.2%)와 추경호 후보(35.1%)의 격차가 14.1%포인트였는데 보름 만에 접전으로 바뀐 것이다. SBS가 입소스에 의뢰해 지난 1~3일 대구 지역 유권자 801명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화면접 조사에서도 김부겸 후보 41%, 추경호 후보 36%로 오차 범위(±3.5%포인트) 이내의 백중세였다.)

Regarding the opposition candidates' pursuit in Yeongnam, Yoon Tae-gon, head of the The More Political Analysis Center, said, "This is because the Democratic Party is showing an arrogant attitude by pushing for the 'fabricated indictment' special counsel law to allow the cancellation of the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung's case." Park Sung-min, head of the political consulting firm 'Min', also said, "The controversies caused by some Democratic Party candidates are also acting as a justification for conservative voters to turn out in the local elections." (영남에서 야권 후보들이 추격세를 보이는 데 대해 윤태곤 더모아 정치분석실장은 “민주당이 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있도록 한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 추진으로 기고만장한 모습을 노출하고 있기 때문”이라고 했다. 박성민 정치컨설팅 ‘민’ 대표도 “일부 민주당 후보가 논란을 일으키는 부분도 보수층이 지방선거에서 투표할 명분으로 작용하고 있다”고 했다.)

Previously, on the 29th of last month, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, running in the Busan Northern Gap by-election, was caught on camera appearing to shake off his hand after shaking hands with merchants at Gupo Market, sparking controversy. On the 3rd, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae and Ha caused another controversy during a campaign rally when they told an elementary school girl, "Try calling him Oppa Jeong-woo." The two later apologized, saying, "We apologize to the child and parents who may have been hurt." (앞서 지난달 29일 부산 북갑 보궐선거에 출마한 민주당 하정우 후보가 구포시장에서 상인들과 악수한 뒤 손을 터는 듯한 장면이 언론에 포착되면서 구설에 올랐다. 지난 3일엔 민주당 정청래 대표와 하 후보가 유세 도중 초등학교 여학생에게 “정우 오빠라고 해보라”고 하면서 논란을 일으키기도 했다. 이후 두 사람은 “상처받았을 아이와 부모님께 사과드린다”고 했다.)

A People Power Party official said, "The so-called 'Try calling Oppa' controversy will likely be reflected in future public opinion in Busan." On the same day, the educational group 'Solidarity for the Protection of Student, Parent, and Teacher Human Rights' filed a complaint with the prosecution against leader Jung and candidate Ha on charges of emotional abuse under the Child Welfare Act. (국민의힘 관계자는 “이른바 ‘오빠 해봐’ 논란은 향후 부산 여론에 반영될 것”이라고 했다. 이날 교육 단체인 ‘학생학부모교사인권보호연대’는 정 대표와 하 후보를 아동복지법상 정서적 학대 혐의로 검찰에 고발하기도 했다.)

Amid this, leader Jung has been on a three-day campaign support tour since the 2nd in Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province; Changwon, South Gyeongsang Province; and Busan. These are areas with relatively strong conservative leanings. On the 4th, Jung stated, "In this local election, we must thoroughly uproot the insurrection forces and those who support the insurrection." (이런 가운데 정 대표는 지난 2일부터 2박 3일 일정으로 경북 포항, 경남 창원, 부산에서 지원 유세를 이어가고 있다. 상대적으로 보수 성향이 강한 지역들이다. 정 대표는 4일 “이번 지방선거에서 내란 세력과 내란 옹호 세력을 확실하게 뿌리 뽑아야 한다”고 했다.)

In related news, Song Young-gil, former Democratic Party leader running in the Incheon Yeonsu Gap by-election, said on YTN Radio that day, "The public sentiment I've gauged is that 'they'd rather leave it to Busan mayor candidate Jeon Jae-soo.' It would be better for (party leaders, etc.) to just provide support from above rather than going there and making mistakes." A Democratic Party campaign official in the Yeongnam region also expressed concern, saying, "Even if it doesn't show immediately, if such incidents accumulate, the election landscape could suddenly turn upside down." (이와 관련해 인천 연수갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 송영길 전 민주당 대표는 이날 YTN라디오에서 “제가 파악한 여론은 ‘전재수 부산시장 후보에게 맡겨 놨으면 좋겠다’는 것”이라며 “(당대표 등이) 거기 가서 실수하기보다는 위에서 그냥 지원해주는 것이 좋을 것”이라고 했다. 민주당 영남 지역 한 캠프 관계자도 “당장 표시가 나지 않더라도 이런 일이 누적되면 판세가 갑자기 뒤집힐 수 있다”고 우려했다.)

As tension rises among Yeongnam candidates, Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said at a press briefing that day, "We must not let our guard down for even a moment. Whether it's a conscious or unconscious remark, we need to think about how it will be received by citizens when it reaches them." (영남권 후보들 중심으로 긴장감이 고조되자 민주당 조승래 사무총장은 이날 기자간담회에서 “한시라도 긴장의 끈을 놓지 말아야 한다”며 “의식적 발언이든 무의식적 발언이든 시민에게 전달됐을 때 어떻게 받아들여질지 생각해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Victor Cha: "North Korea Allows Soccer Team to Visit South Korea Amid Stalled Dialogue… Shows Room for Conversation" (빅터 차 “北, 대화 단절 속 축구단 남한 방문 허용… 대화 여지 있다”)
item.description:
Victor Cha: "North Korea Allows Soccer Team to Visit South Korea Amid Stalled Dialogue… Shows Room for Conversation" (빅터 차 “北, 대화 단절 속 축구단 남한 방문 허용… 대화 여지 있다”)

The Naegohyang Women's Football Team, based in Pyongyang, is set to visit South Korea for the first time in eight years as a North Korean delegation to compete in the semifinals of the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League. In this context, Victor Cha, the Korea Chair at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) in Washington, D.C., and a Korean Peninsula expert, stated on the 4th, "South Korea has successfully used sports to achieve diplomatic goals. While it's difficult to assert whether a diplomatic breakthrough will materialize, this event demonstrates the possibility of separating cultural exchange from politics and also shows that there is room for dialogue between the two Koreas." The Korea Chair is a research program operated with support from the Korea Foundation (KF), an organization under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. <<> Cha, who served as Director for Asian Affairs on the National Security Council (NSC) at the White House under the George W. Bush administration and was involved in U.S.-North Korea dialogue, has been classified as a hardliner on North Korea. Recently, however, he has advocated for a "cold peace" with North Korea, arguing that "immediate denuclearization has become difficult to achieve." This stance has drawn considerable attention from South Korea's progressive camp, which values dialogue with the North. In a co-authored piece with researcher Andy Lim on the same day, Cha wrote, "In a situation where North Korea has severed all dialogue with South Korea and designated Seoul as a hostile state, the fact that Pyongyang has allowed its athletes to visit South Korea is highly significant. This soccer match shows the potential to separate cultural exchange from politics." <<> Cha noted that this event follows North Korea's conciliatory response in April when the South Korean government expressed regret over an alleged "unauthorized North Korean incursion into South Korean airspace" by drones. He said, "This shows there is room for inter-Korean dialogue." Regarding the possibility of a meeting between Kim Jong Un and former President Donald Trump during his visit to China on the 14th and 15th of this month, Cha stated, "Trump may once again propose a meeting with Kim Jong Un. If such a meeting materializes, it is likely to occur after Trump’s talks with Xi Jinping." A White House official stated on the same day that there is no official schedule for a summit between the U.S. and North Korean leaders. (평양을 연고로 하는 내고향여자축구단이 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그 준결승을 위해 북한 선수단으로는 8년 만에 처음으로 한국을 방문할 예정인 가운데, 워싱턴 DC의 한반도 전문가인 빅터 차 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS) 한국 석좌는 4일 “한국은 스포츠를 활용해 외교적 목표를 달성하는 데 성공해 왔다”며 “외교적 돌파구 마련 여부를 단정하기는 어렵지만 이번 경기가 문화 교류와 정치를 분리할 수 있는 가능성을 보여주는 동시에 남북 간 대화의 여지가 있음을 보여주는 것”이라고 했다. 한국 석좌는 외교부 산하 기관인 한국국제교류재단(KF)의 지원을 받아 운영되는 연구 프로그램이다.)

item.title: Pyeongtaek B District: A Back-and-Forth Battle… Kim Yong-nam, Yoo Ui-dong, and Cho Kuk Still Locked in a Tight 20% Range (평택乙 엎치락뒤치락… 김용남·유의동·조국 여전히 20%대 박빙)
item.description:
Pyeongtaek B District: A Back-and-Forth Battle… Kim Yong-nam, Yoo Ui-dong, and Cho Kuk Still Locked in a Tight 20% Range (평택乙 엎치락뒤치락… 김용남·유의동·조국 여전히 20%대 박빙)

The five-way race for the National Assembly by-election in Pyeongtaek B District, Gyeonggi Province, is turning into a neck-and-neck contest. The three candidates—Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party, and Cho Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party—are all recording approval ratings in the 20% range within the margin of error in recent polls. With the other two minor party candidates also securing around 10% support, there are projections that candidate unification could ultimately decide the outcome. (5자 구도로 치러지고 있는 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거가 혼전 양상이다. 더불어민주당 김용남, 국민의힘 유의동, 조국혁신당 조국 등 3명 후보가 최근 여론조사에서 오차 범위 안 20%대 지지율을 기록 중이다. 나머지 2명의 군소 정당 후보도 10% 안팎의 지지율을 보이면서 결국 후보 단일화가 승패를 좌우할 것이란 전망이 나온다.)

In a survey commissioned by News Tomato and conducted by polling agency Media Tomato on the 1st and 2nd of this month, candidate Kim Yong-nam led with 28.8%, followed by Yoo Ui-dong at 22.5% and Cho Kuk at 22.2%. The gap between candidates falls within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). Additionally, Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party received 8.9%, and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party got 8.8%. (뉴스토마토 의뢰로 여론조사 업체 미디어토마토가 지난 1~2일 시행한 여론조사에선 김용남 후보 28.8%, 유의동 후보 22.5%, 조국 후보 22.2% 순이었다. 후보 간 격차는 오차 범위(±3.5%포인트) 안이다. 이 밖에 자유와혁신 황교안 후보 8.9%, 진보당 김재연 후보 8.8%였다.)

In another survey by Incheon Ilbo and Han Gil Research during the same period, Kim Yong-nam stood at 30.8%, Cho Kuk at 23.0%, and Yoo Ui-dong at 19.8%. The gaps between first and second, and second and third, were within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party registered 9.6% and 9.3%, respectively. When asked about the most suitable candidate if Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk were to unify, Cho received 33.8% and Kim got 30.4%. (같은 기간 인천일보·한길리서치 조사에서도 김용남 후보 30.8%, 조국 후보 23.0%, 유의동 후보 19.8%였다. 1.2위, 2.3위 간 격차가 오차 범위(±4.4%포인트) 내였다. 자유와혁신 황교안, 진보당 김재연 후보는 각각 9.6%, 9.3%였다. 김용남·조국 후보가 단일화할 경우 적임자를 묻는 조사에서는 조 후보 33.8%, 김 후보 30.4%였다.)

A survey from Pressian and the Korea Society Opinion Institute on the 25th and 26th of last month also showed Kim Yong-nam at 21.4%, Yoo Ui-dong at 21.2%, and Cho Kuk at 23.4%. All top three candidates were in the 20% range, within the margin of error (±3.7 percentage points). Hwang Kyo-ahn and Kim Jae-yeon received 12.0% and 9.4%, respectively. (프레시안·한국사회여론연구소의 지난달 25~26일 조사에서도 김용남 후보 21.4%, 유의동 후보 21.2%, 조국 후보 23.4%였다. 1·2·3위가 모두 20%대로 오차 범위(±3.7%포인트) 안이었다. 황교안, 김재연 후보는 각각 12.0%, 9.4%였다.)

Even if unification occurs within the conservative or progressive blocs, it does not simply add up their support rates, but in Pyeongtaek B District, late-stage unification is expected to impact the outcome. In fact, while the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party officially maintain that "there will be no unification," a tense rivalry persists. Candidate Kim Yong-nam said on a radio show on the 4th, "It doesn't seem like the right time to discuss unification," and Cho Kuk, the previous day on Facebook, stated, "I will trust only the public sentiment, give my all, and win by a margin of three votes," drawing a line against unification. (보수, 진보 진영 내 단일화가 이뤄져도 지지율이 단순 합산되는 건 아니지만 평택을은 막판 단일화가 승패에 영향을 미칠 것으로 보인다. 실제 민주당과 조국혁신당은 공식적으로 “단일화는 없다”는 입장이지만 신경전이 이어지고 있다. 김용남 후보는 4일 라디오에서 “(단일화를) 논의할 상황은 전혀 아닌 것 같다”고 했고, 조국 후보도 전날 페이스북에 “오로지 민심만 믿고 전력투구해 3표 차이로 승리할 것”이라며 단일화와 선을 그었다.)

However, within the Democratic Party, there are voices arguing for a merger. A key party leadership official said, "To protect our seats in the National Assembly, the principle is to win by-elections in districts that Democrats have previously held in the National Assembly without fail," adding, "We'll discuss this further as we monitor poll trends." Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae also commented, "If there is demand for unification at the local level, we won't block it." Meanwhile, unification between Yoo Ui-dong and Hwang Kyo-ahn appears unlikely. A People Power Party official noted, "The ideology and values of the two candidates differ," and "Even if the other side unifies, Yoo can still win on his own." (하지만 민주당 내에선 합칠 필요가 있다는 주장이 나온다. 당 지도부 핵심 관계자는 “국회 의석을 지키기 위해서라도 직전까지 민주당이 국회의원을 지낸 재보선 지역은 무조건 승리한다는 게 원칙”이라며 “여론조사 추이를 보고 차차 논의할 문제”라고 했다. 조승래 사무총장도 “지역 차원에서 단일화 수요가 있으면 차단하진 않겠다”고 했다. 다만 유의동 후보와 황교안 후보 간 단일화는 쉽지 않을 전망이다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “두 후보 간 이념, 가치가 다르다”며 “저쪽이 합치더라도 유 후보 혼자서도 충분히 이길 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Issues Directive: ‘Special Counsel Needed, but Pace Should Be Controlled’ (‘특검 필요, 속도는 조절’ 지침 내린 李)
item.description:
Lee Issues Directive: ‘Special Counsel Needed, but Pace Should Be Controlled’ (‘특검 필요, 속도는 조절’ 지침 내린 李)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 4th regarding the handling of the ‘fabricated indictment’ special counsel bill, “As for the specific timing and procedures, I ask the ruling Democratic Party to decide after gathering public opinion and going through a deliberation process.” The special counsel bill proposed by the Democratic Party includes provisions that could allow for the dismissal of indictments related to President Lee’s cases. The presidential office had not previously taken a stance on this special counsel concerning President Lee’s cases, but this marks its first public expression of support. (이재명 대통령은 4일 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 처리와 관련해 “구체적 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 더불어민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해 달라”고 했다. 민주당이 발의한 특검법엔 이 대통령 관련 사건들을 공소 취소할 수 있는 내용이 담겨 있다. 청와대는 그간 이 대통령 사건과 관련된 이번 특검에 입장을 밝히지 않았는데 처음 공개적으로 찬성 입장을 낸 것이다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo held a briefing at the presidential office that day and said, “The parliamentary investigation has largely revealed illegal acts and unfair investigations conducted by the Yoon Seok-youl regime and political prosecutors,” adding, “A public consensus has also formed on the need for a special counsel investigation to rectify this.” (홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 이날 청와대에서 브리핑을 열고 “국정조사를 통해 윤석열 정권과 정치검찰에 의해 자행된 불법 행위와 부당한 수사 등이 상당 부분 밝혀졌다”며 “이를 바로잡기 위한 특검 수사 필요성에 대해서도 국민적 공감대가 형성됐다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party, through the National Assembly’s ‘fabricated indictment parliamentary investigation,’ has designated seven cases, including the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangul North Korea remittance cases, as fabricated indictments. Additionally, it has proposed a ‘fabricated indictment’ special counsel bill to investigate five other cases, including President Lee’s alleged violation of the Public Official Election Act. The party is pushing to bring the bill to a plenary session as early as the 7th. In response, there have been concerns within the Democratic Party that this could become a liability in the local elections, leading the presidential office to directly mention the need for opinion gathering and deliberation on the timing of the matter. (민주당은 국회 ‘조작 기소 국정조사’를 통해 대장동, 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건 등 7개 사건을 조작 기소로 규정했고, 이에 더해 이 대통령의 공직선거법 위반 등 다른 5개 사건까지 포함해 수사하는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법을 발의했다. 이르면 7일 본회의에 상정하는 방안을 추진하고 있다. 이에 대해 민주당 내부에서도 “지방선거에 악재가 될 수 있다”는 우려가 나왔고, 이날 청와대가 직접 나서 처리 시기에 대해 의견 수렴과 숙의 필요성을 언급한 것이다.)

Nevertheless, the presidential office clearly stated its stance in favor of the special counsel, saying, “Revealing the truth and restoring judicial justice through a special counsel is something that must be done.” A presidential office official remarked, “The judgment that there were fabricated investigations and indictments in the president’s cases is clear,” while another ruling party insider said, “In effect, the president issued a specific directive to handle the special counsel bill right after the local elections.” (다만 청와대는 “특검을 통해 진실을 규명하고 사법적 정의를 바로 세우는 것은 반드시 해야 할 일”이라며 특검 찬성 입장을 명확히 밝혔다. 청와대 관계자는 “대통령 사건에서 조작 수사·기소가 있었다는 판단은 명확하다”고 했고, 다른 여권 인사는 “사실상 대통령이 지방선거 직후에는 특검법을 처리하라는 구체적인 지침을 내린 것”이라고 했다.)

The People Power Party responded, “At a time when a promise to the public not to pursue a special counsel is needed, they instead said a special counsel is necessary,” adding, “This has revealed to the world that the mastermind behind the ‘self-criminal laundering’ scenario is the president himself.” (국민의힘은 “특검 자체를 하지 않겠다는 대국민 약속이 필요한 상황에서 오히려 특검이 필요하다고 했다”며 “‘셀프 범죄 세탁’ 시나리오의 배후 설계자가 대통령 본인임을 만천하에 드러낸 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: North Korean Women's Football Team Arrives, First Sports Exchange in 8 Years (北 여자 축구팀 온다, 8년 만에 체육 교류)
item.description:
North Korean Women's Football Team Arrives, First Sports Exchange in 8 Years (北 여자 축구팀 온다, 8년 만에 체육 교류)

North Korea's women's football club team, "Naegohyang Women's Football Team," is visiting the South to participate in the semifinals of the 2025–2026 Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League. This marks the first visit of a North Korean sports delegation to the South in about eight years, since the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) World Tour Grand Finals held in Incheon in 2018. It is also the first such visit since North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un defined inter-Korean relations as "hostile belligerent relations" at the end of 2023. <<> According to the Korea Football Association and the Ministry of Unification on the 4th, "Naegohyang Women's Football Team" will play the semifinal match against "Suwon FC Women" at Suwon Stadium on the 20th at 7 p.m. A Ministry of Unification official stated, "North Korea sent its intention to participate in the match and the player roster to the AFC on the 1st, and the AFC notified the Korea Football Association of the list. Accordingly, the government will proceed with procedures for the North Korean delegation's visit to the South." <<> Kim Jong Un last month declared that "South Korea is recognized as the most hostile state." Analysts suggest that the unprecedented decision to visit the South may have been influenced by factors such as a $1 million (approximately 1.47 billion won) prize for winning. If Naegohyang Women's Football Team defeats Suwon FC Women, they will receive at least $500,000 (approximately 735 million won) as the runner-up prize. Conversely, if they do not participate in the match, they would face a minimum fine of $100,000 (approximately 147 million won) under AFC regulations. <<> Cheong Wa Dae stated on the same day, "We welcome Naegohyang Women's Football Team's participation in the AFC Women's Champions League semifinals. The government will cooperate with the AFC and Suwon FC to ensure the team can carry out the match smoothly." <<> ◇North Korean Football Club Enters via Beijing… If They Win, It May Be Used for Regime Propaganda <<> It is reported that North Korea only notified the AFC of its participation in the Women's Champions League semifinals and the player list on the 1st at around 6 p.m. This was a somewhat belated decision compared to the other semifinalists—Australia's Melbourne City FC and Japan's Tokyo Verdy Beleza—who submitted their player rosters around last month, after the AFC confirmed the semifinals and finals would be held in South Korea at the end of March. There was no direct communication between South and North Korean authorities in the process of notifying participation. The South Korean government reportedly received related information through the Korea Football Association. <<> North Korea has notified that a total of 39 people will visit the South, including 27 players (including four reserves) and 12 support staff. They are expected to arrive at Incheon Airport on the 17th via Beijing, China, and, following convention, stay at the same accommodation as the opposing team, Suwon FC Women. A Ministry of Unification official said, "Since this is a club competition, not a national contest, and a purely civilian sports event, the government will comply with AFC regulations and fulfill its role within the framework of international sports." <<> Naegohyang Women's Football Team, founded in 2012 with Pyongyang as its home base, is a club team sponsored by Naegohyang Trading Company, which produces "Naegohyang Soju" and "Naegohyang Cigarettes." Many of its players are national team-level talents who have recently won age-group World Cups (U-17 and U-20). In the group stage held last year, they defeated their semifinal opponent Suwon FC Women 3-0. Analysts suggest that North Korea's decision to send this team to South Korea, despite not dispatching athletes to the World Archery Championships held in Gwangju last September, also considered the high likelihood of victory. <<> North Korea tends to actively participate in international competitions in sports where it achieves good results, such as football and wrestling, and uses victories as material for regime propaganda. It has also submitted an intention to participate in the Asian Games to be held in Nagoya, Japan this September, and has signaled the dispatch of a large delegation. If Naegohyang Women's Football Team wins against Suwon FC Women, there is a possibility it will tout this as a victory in an "inter-Korean showdown." In that case, Naegohyang Women's Football Team will play the final match in Suwon on the 23rd at 2 p.m. and return to North Korea on the 24th. (북한의 여자 축구 클럽팀 ‘내고향여자축구단’이 2025~2026시즌 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스 리그 준결승 경기에 참가하기 위해 방남(訪南)한다. 북한 선수단의 방남은 2018년 인천에서 열린 국제탁구연맹(ITTF) 월드투어 그랜드파이널스 대회 이후 약 8년 만이다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 2023년 말 남북 관계를 ‘적대적인 교전국 관계’로 규정한 이후 처음이다.)

item.title: Special Prosecution to Target Lee’s Election Law Case, Effectively a Final Conviction (사실상 확정 판결 난 李선거법 사건, 수사 대상 삼겠다는 특검)
item.description:
Special Prosecution to Target Lee’s Election Law Case, Effectively a Final Conviction (사실상 확정 판결 난 李선거법 사건, 수사 대상 삼겠다는 특검)

The Democratic Party of Korea’s “fabricated indictment” special prosecution law includes in its investigation scope the public official election law violation case of President Lee Jae-myung, which the Supreme Court has already remanded with a guilty finding. Under the Criminal Procedure Act, indictment cancellation is only possible for cases before the first trial verdict, so this case does not qualify for such cancellation. (더불어민주당의 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 수사 대상에는 이미 대법원이 유죄 취지로 파기환송한 이재명 대통령의 공직선거법 위반 사건까지 포함됐다. 형사소송법상 공소 취소는 1심 판결 전인 사건만 가능하기 때문에 이 사건은 공소 취소 대상이 아니다.)

However, it has been learned on the 4th that some hardliners within the Democratic Party are arguing that “if the election law case is also revealed to be a fabricated indictment through a special prosecution investigation, the Criminal Procedure Act should be amended to cancel the indictment.” Initially, this case was not subject to the parliamentary investigation by the special committee on the fabricated indictment probe, but it has been included in the scope of the special prosecution’s investigation. Since the special prosecution also has the authority to forcibly transfer indicted cases if necessary, the aim is to re-investigate and overturn the election law case. (하지만 민주당 강경파 일각에선 “선거법 사건 역시 특검 수사로 조작 기소가 밝혀지면 형사소송법을 개정해서라도 공소 취소해야 한다”는 주장이 나오는 것으로 4일 알려졌다. 당초 이 사건은 조작기소 국정조사 특위의 조사 대상이 아니었지만 특검의 수사 범위에 포함됐다. 특검은 필요한 경우 기소된 사건을 강제로 이첩 받을 권한도 갖고 있기 때문에 선거법 사건도 재수사해 뒤집겠다는 것이다.)

President Lee’s election law violation case involves charges of publishing false information related to the “golf remarks” about the late Kim Moon-ki and the “Baekhyeon-dong intimidation remarks against the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport” made in late 2021, just before the 2022 presidential election. The Supreme Court overturned the second trial verdict of not guilty in May last year and sent the case back to the Seoul High Court. If the election law case is ultimately confirmed as guilty, the Democratic Party will have to refund approximately 43 billion won in state subsidies received as campaign funds for that election. However, the trial in this case has been suspended since the president’s election. <<> The Democratic Party’s outlook is mixed on whether it can actually cancel the indictment for the election law case. One Democratic Party lawmaker, who is listed as a sponsor of the special prosecution law, said, “Without amending the Criminal Procedure Act, it is difficult to cancel the indictment for an election law case that the Supreme Court has already remanded with a guilty finding,” adding, “Amending the Criminal Procedure Act is also expected to face significant resistance, so it won’t be easy.” However, some hardline lawmakers reportedly hold the position that “since the president is an unjust victim, the indictment must be canceled unconditionally.” On the 30th of last month, when the special prosecution law was proposed, strong supporters also posted comments on conservative-leaning internet communities saying, “Only by revising the Criminal Procedure Act to expand the scope of indictment cancellation to include cases at the first, second, and third trial stages can the president be free.” <<> Even if the Democratic Party pushes the special prosecution law through the National Assembly despite opposition from the opposition camp and the legal community, the process of selecting special prosecutors is expected to face difficulties. This is because the special prosecution must investigate prosecutors handling the president’s case for fabricated indictments and bear the political burden of leading the cancellation of the indictment. This special prosecution will be the largest in history, consisting of a total of 357 personnel, including the special prosecutor, deputy special prosecutors, and dispatched officials. A member of the special committee for the parliamentary investigation also said, “Finding a special prosecutor in a short period of time will not be easy.” (이 대통령의 선거법 위반 사건은 2022년 대선 직전인 2021년 말 고(故) 김문기와의 ‘골프 발언’과 ‘백현동 국토부 협박 발언’과 관련해 허위 사실을 공표했다는 혐의로 기소된 건이다. 대법원은 작년 5월 무죄를 선고한 2심을 깨고 이 사건을 서울고등법원으로 돌려보냈다. 향후 선거법 사건이 유죄로 확정되면 민주당은 당시 대선 비용으로 받았던 약 430억원의 국고보조금을 토해내야 한다. 다만 이 사건은 대통령 당선 이후 재판이 중단된 상태다.)

item.title: Blue House: "Long-Term Holding Deduction Naturally Maintained... Protecting Those Residing in Their Single Home" (靑 “장특공 당연히 유지… 실거주 1주택자들 보호”)
item.description:
Blue House: "Long-Term Holding Deduction Naturally Maintained... Protecting Those Residing in Their Single Home" (靑 “장특공 당연히 유지… 실거주 1주택자들 보호”)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the Office of Policy Coordination at the Blue House, stated on the 4th regarding the long-term holding special deduction system that "it is naturally maintained" and "we will ensure there are no issues in protecting the residential stability of single-home owners who actually reside in their property." <<> During a briefing at the Blue House's Chunchugwan, Director Kim said, "Both residence and holding periods currently have the same maximum deduction rate of 40%, so we need to consider whether this aligns with restructuring the housing market toward actual residence." This is interpreted as a move to significantly reduce the deduction rate based on the holding period. Under the current system, single-home owners can receive a maximum deduction of 40% (for 10 years or more) based on the holding period and another maximum of 40% (for 10 years or more) based on the residence period. <<> Director Kim stated, "It is entirely false that the long-term holding deduction for actual residents will be reduced." If the government reduces the deduction rate for holding periods, unless it increases the deduction rate for residence periods, single-home owners who actually reside in their property will inevitably see a reduction in their long-term holding deduction benefits. Regarding cases where individuals become non-resident single-home owners unavoidably due to work or education, Director Kim said, "We will gather opinions to ensure they are not disadvantaged." <<> Director Kim evaluated that the scheduled expiration of the heavy capital gains tax deferral for multi-home owners on the 9th has led to an increase in housing listings and a narrowing of the asset inequality gap. However, regarding the future outlook for the real estate market, he said, "Areas like Gangnam's three districts and Yongsan will experience a gradual rise as they return to their proper positions." <<> Regarding the overall real estate tax reform, Director Kim said, "President Yoon has announced a rationalization of housing taxes by differentiating by type, such as multi-home owners, non-resident single-home owners, and ultra-high-value homes," adding, "Relevant ministries and research organizations are reviewing various alternatives." <<> He added, "We are also preparing legislative measures to allow for comprehensive investigations and potential sale orders for speculative elements not only in housing but also in farmland that seeks capital gains," and "Since the real estate market has entered a very difficult normalization phase, we will manage it to prevent it from deviating." In February, President Yoon instructed relevant ministries during a cabinet meeting to conduct a full investigation of farmland not used for farming and issue forced sale orders, saying, "Even farmland has become a target of speculation." <<> The government signaled its intention to maintain strict loan restrictions. Director Kim said, "We will block any aspects where finance is used for speculative purposes," and "It is natural to prevent loans for what is deemed unrelated to actual demand." <<> Director Kim stated, "We held private discussions on issues such as facilitating the release of properties from non-resident single-home owners, and determining whether it is appropriate or excessive for rental business owners to retain permanent benefits after their 8-year rental business period ends, and how to adjust this," adding, "We are refining the plans." <<> Regarding the scheduled expiration of the heavy capital gains tax deferral for multi-home owners on the 9th, he said, "According to statistics from March, the number of Seoul apartment sales by multi-home owners was 2,087 cases, up 32% from the monthly average of 1,577 last year," and "Looking at the buyers, 73% were those without homes." <<> He particularly noted the reduction in real estate price increases in the so-called "Gangnam three districts" and Yongsan-gu. He assessed, "The Gangnam three districts and Yongsan-gu have led the housing price increases in the past, but the fact that they declined first is very unusual in the context of Korea's housing market trends and history." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 4일 장기보유특별공제(장특공제)에 대해 “당연히 유지가 된다”며 “실거주하는 1주택자들의 주거 보호에 문제가 없도록 할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: PPP Fails to Decide on Chung Jin-suk’s Candidacy (정진석 공천 여부, 결론 못 내린 국힘)
item.description:
PPP Fails to Decide on Chung Jin-suk’s Candidacy (정진석 공천 여부, 결론 못 내린 국힘)

The People Power Party (PPP) nomination management committee held a plenary meeting on the 4th to discuss whether to grant Chung Jin-suk, a former National Assembly vice speaker, a nomination for the by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong Province, but failed to reach a conclusion. Former Vice Speaker Chung, who served as former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s chief of staff, faces fierce opposition within the party due to his “pro-Yoon” alignment. (국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 4일 전체회의를 열고 정진석 전 국회 부의장의 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 공천 여부를 논의했지만 결론을 내리지 못했다. 윤석열 전 대통령 비서실장을 지낸 정 전 부의장은 ‘친윤’이라는 점 때문에 당내 반발이 거세다.)

PPP Nomination Management Committee Chairman Park Deok-heum told reporters immediately after the meeting, “The ethics committee didn’t hold a meeting, so we couldn’t reach a conclusion.” Former Vice Speaker Chung, who has been indicted in the insurrection special counsel investigation, is currently disqualified from applying for various primary contests under the PPP’s party constitution and rules. The implication is that the nomination committee cannot make a decision because the ethics committee has not ruled on whether to recognize any exceptional grounds. Chairman Park said, “A plenary meeting is scheduled for the 7th. If the ethics committee holds a meeting by then, we will proceed with interviews and such, even if it’s late.” <<> PPP candidates for metropolitan government heads are criticizing former Vice Speaker Chung’s nomination application. South Chungcheong Governor Kim Tae-heum, in opposition, indefinitely postponed his preliminary candidate registration, which had been scheduled for the same day. Governor Kim, who had even hinted at leaving the party, appeared on TV Chosun’s YouTube channel and said, “It’s not reasonable for someone who served as former President Yoon’s last chief of staff and participated in his martial law to now run for office.” Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho also expressed concerns one after another. <<> However, former Vice Speaker Chung pushed back, stating in a Facebook post, “How would it look to the public when even those who easily became governors or mayors thanks to him (former President Yoon) step up and viciously attack me, saying ‘Chung Jin-suk won’t do’?” Former Vice Speaker Chung is demanding a guarantee of participation in the primary. <<> It is reported that the party leadership is leaning toward the view that excluding former Vice Speaker Chung from the primary is inevitable, given the deteriorating public sentiment. A party leadership official said, “It’s true that former Vice Speaker Chung, a five-term lawmaker representing Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, has the highest competitiveness,” but added, “It’s difficult to ignore the Democratic Party’s framing of ‘Yoon again’ and ‘insurrection.’” (박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 이날 회의 직후 기자들과 만나 “윤리위원회 회의가 안 열려서 결론을 못 냈다”고 말했다. 내란 특검에 기소된 정 전 부의장은 국민의힘 당헌·당규에 따라 각종 경선 공모 응모 자격이 정지된 상태다. 윤리위에서 예외 사유로 인정할지를 판단해주지 않아 공관위에서 결정할 수 없다는 취지다. 박 위원장은 “7일 전체회의가 예정돼 있다. 윤리위가 그 안에 회의를 열면 늦게라도 면접 등을 진행하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party: Crew Safety Top Priority After Explosion on Korean-Operated Ship in Hormuz (與, 호르무즈 韓선사 운용 선박내 폭발에 “선원 안전 최우선”)
item.description:
Ruling Party: Crew Safety Top Priority After Explosion on Korean-Operated Ship in Hormuz (與, 호르무즈 韓선사 운용 선박내 폭발에 “선원 안전 최우선”)

The Democratic Party of Korea stated on the 4th, in relation to an explosion that occurred on a ship operated by a Korean shipping company in the Strait of Hormuz, that “we will monitor the situation and take all possible measures to ensure the safety and safe return of the crew.” <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon said this in a written briefing, adding, “We join the people in praying for the safety of the crew and the ship.” <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang said, “Fortunately, there are no reports of casualties, but traces of an explosion on the port side of the engine room have been reported. item.title: Government Holds Meeting on Explosion and Fire Involving Korean Ship in the Strait of Hormuz (정부, 호르무즈 韓 선박 폭발·화재 관련 대책회의 개최)
item.description:
Government Holds Meeting on Explosion and Fire Involving Korean Ship in the Strait of Hormuz (정부, 호르무즈 韓 선박 폭발·화재 관련 대책회의 개최)

The government convened a meeting of the Overseas Nationals Protection Headquarters in response to an explosion and fire involving a Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz. (정부가 호르무즈 해협 내에서 발생한 한국 선박 폭발·화재와 관련해 재외국민보호대책본부 회의를 개최했다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the meeting was held at midnight on the 5th, chaired by Second Vice Minister Kim Jin-ah, with officials from seven diplomatic missions in the Middle East and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries in attendance. (외교부에 따르면 회의는 5일 0시 김진아 2차관 주재로 열렸으며 중동 지역 7개 공관과 해양수산부 관계자들이 참석했다.)

Earlier, at 8:40 p.m. on the 4th (Korean time), an explosion and fire occurred on the Panama-flagged vessel HMM 'NAMU', operated by a Korean shipping company, while it was anchored in waters near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) within the Strait of Hormuz. (앞서 4일 오후 8시 40분(한국 시각) 호르무즈 해협 내 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박 중이던 우리 선사가 운용하는 파나마 국적 선박 HMM ‘나무(NAMU)’호에서 폭발·화재가 발생했다.)

The government is investigating the exact circumstances, including the possibility that the cargo ship was attacked. On the morning of the 5th, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, "It is uncertain whether the ship can operate normally. It will be towed to a nearby port to assess damages and undergo repairs. The exact cause of the accident is expected to be determined through the damage assessment process after towing." (정부는 화물선이 공격받았을 가능성 등 정확한 경위를 파악 중이다. 외교부는 5일 오전 “선박의 정상 운항 가능 여부는 불확실해 인근 항구로 예인한 뒤 피해 상태 등을 확인하고 수리 예정”이라며 “정확한 사고 원인은 선박 예인 후 피해 상태를 확인하는 과정에서 파악 가능할 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

The Embassy in the UAE and the Consulate General in Dubai contacted the shipping company and relevant agencies immediately after the incident to confirm the safety of Korean sailors and request necessary assistance. (주아랍에미리트대사관과 주두바이총영사관은 사건 발생 직후 선사·유관기관 등을 접촉해 한국 선원의 안전을 확인하고 필요한 조력을 요청했다.)

During the meeting, Vice Minister Kim expressed deep concern over the first instance of damage to a Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz since the outbreak of the Middle East war. The ministry added that Kim emphasized the need to identify the cause and prevent recurrence, noting that while there were no casualties this time, it is crucial to be fully prepared to take swift measures to protect the lives and safety of Korean sailors at all times. (김 차관은 이날 대책회의에서 중동 전쟁 발발 이후 처음으로 호르무즈 해협 내에서 한국 선박에 피해가 발생한 데 대해 깊은 우려를 표했다. 이어 다행히 이번에는 인명 피해가 없었지만, 원인 파악과 함께 재발 방지 노력이 필요하다며 언제든지 한국 선원의 생명과 안전을 보호하기 위해 필요한 조치를 신속하게 취할 수 있도록 만반의 준비를 해두는 게 중요하다고 했다고 외교부는 전했다.)

The attending diplomatic missions reported that they have been in constant communication with host country authorities, actively taking measures to protect and support Korean ships and sailors. They stated they would further strengthen cooperation with host nations to ensure prompt rescue and safety of Korean sailors in emergencies. (참석 공관들은 주재국 관계 당국과 상시 소통하며 우리 선박과 선원을 보호하고 지원하기 위해 필요한 조치를 적극 취해 왔다며 유사시 즉각적으로 우리 선원 구조 등 안전 확보가 가능하도록 주재국 측과의 공조 체제를 더욱 강화해 나가겠다고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Chooses Park Min-sik as Candidate for Busan North Gap By-election... Unity with Independent Han Dong-hoon Draws Attention (국힘, 부산 북갑 후보에 박민식... 무소속 한동훈과 단일화 주목)
item.description:
People Power Party Chooses Park Min-sik as Candidate for Busan North Gap By-election... Unity with Independent Han Dong-hoon Draws Attention (국힘, 부산 북갑 후보에 박민식... 무소속 한동훈과 단일화 주목)

The People Power Party confirmed on the 5th that former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik will be its candidate for the June 3 Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election. (국민의힘이 6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관을 5일 확정했다.)

The party's Nomination Committee announced that day that Park won the final candidacy after combining party member votes (50%) and a general public opinion poll (50%) conducted over the 3rd and 4th, defeating former KBS reporter Lee Young-pung. With this, the People Power Party has completed nominations for 12 out of 14 districts in this by-election. (국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 3~4일 양일간 진행한 당원 투표(50%)와 일반 국민 여론조사(50%)를 합산한 결과 박 후보가 이영풍 전 KBS 기자를 꺾고 최종 후보로 결정됐다고 이날 밝혔다. 이로써 국민의힘은 이번 선거 재보궐선거 지역 14곳 중 12곳의 공천을 완료했다.)

Park, a native of Busan, graduated from Gupo Elementary School, Gupo Middle School, and Busan National University's Teacher's College High School. He served as a two-term lawmaker for Busan's North and Gangseo Gap districts and worked as the first Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration. (부산 출신인 박 후보는 구포초, 구포중, 부산대 사대부고를 졸업했다. 부산 북·강서갑에서 재선 의원을 지냈으며 윤석열 정부 초대 국가보훈부 장관으로 근무했다.)

As Park has been confirmed as the People Power Party candidate, attention is now focused on whether opposition forces will unite in the Busan North Gap by-election. Former party leader Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the People Power Party, has already registered as an independent preliminary candidate in this district. Recent opinion polls show Park, Han, and Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo with similar approval ratings, leading many to predict that the decision on unification will significantly impact the outcome. (국민의힘 후보가 박 후보로 결정되면서 부산 북갑 보궐선거에서 야권 연대 여부가 주목을 받게 됐다. 이 지역에선 국민의힘에서 제명당한 한동훈 전 대표가 무소속으로 예비후보 등록을 마친 상황이다. 최근 각종 여론조사에선 박 후보, 한 후보, 더불어민주당 하정우 후보가 비슷한 지지율을 보이고 있어 단일화 여부가 당락의 영향을 줄 것이라는 전망이 많다.)

Meanwhile, Nomination Committee Chairman Park Deok-heum told reporters that regarding former National Assembly Vice Speaker Chung Jin-suk, who applied for nomination in the Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang by-election in South Chungcheong Province, "If the Ethics Committee meeting proceeds as scheduled on the 7th, we will convene a meeting to discuss the results." Former Vice Speaker Chung, a former chief of staff to President Yoon Seok-yeol, is currently under indictment in the insurrection special counsel case, which has suspended his eligibility to participate in various primary competitions under the party's constitution and regulations. The Nomination Committee will decide on his nomination after the Ethics Committee determines whether to recognize an exception. (한편 박덕흠 당 공관위원장은 이날 기자들과 만나 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거에 공천 신청을 한 정진석 전 국회부의장과 관련해 “윤리위가 7일 예정대로 열린다면 그 결과를 받아 회의 소집해 논의할 것”이라고 말했다. 정 전 부의장은 윤석열 전 대통령 비서실장 출신으로, 내란 특검에 기소된 상태라 국민의힘 당헌·당규에 따라 각종 경선 공모 응모 자격이 정지된 상태다. 윤리위에서 예외 사유로 인정할지를 판단한 뒤 공관위가 공천 여부를 결정하겠다는 것이다.)

Chairman Park also stated that candidate Kim Hyuk-jong, who had applied for nomination in the same district, was deemed ineligible by the Clean Nomination Support Team and thus could not register as a candidate or undergo an interview. (또 박 위원장은 같은 지역에 공천을 신청했던 김혁종 후보는 클린공천지원단에서 부적격 판정을 받아 후보자 등록 및 면접을 하지 못했다고 했다.)
